tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Startup Resources, Leaderboard companies and guides by words. Filter by type and region. Up to 25 results, best first.

tools.name: events
tools.description: Events on the Colorado Startups calendar between two days, soonest first. Up to 25.

tools.name: region
tools.description: One region: its summary, cities and counts, with up to 10 resources, 10 companies and 5 upcoming events.

tools.name: path
tools.description: A short path for a founder at one stage: up to 5 Startup Resources, in the order of the stage's steps, each with one line on why it fits. Add what they need and their region to narrow it.

tools.name: company
tools.description: One Leaderboard honoree's public record: what it does, sector, city, region, boards, website and sources. Find the id with search.

tools.name: guide
tools.description: One founder guide from coloradostartups.org/guides/: its title, summary and full answer, with a link. Find the slug with search, type guide.

tools.name: this_week
tools.description: The events in the next 7 days, today included, in Mountain Time: up to 10, soonest first. Add a region to narrow it.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
